arguments.style: Korean-language toddler sing-along for ages 2 to 4, adapting the supplied C2 source song. Preserve its bright friendly female lead character and bouncy dance-pop groove, approximately 114 BPM, with a light bass pulse, clean rhythmic guitar, bright plucks and crisp soft handclaps. Let the melody breathe naturally around Korean syllables. Very clear native Korean diction, small comfortable vocal range, playful short repeated motifs, memorable sung refrain, easy downbeat emphasis on 사과 and 바나나. Brief one-bar pickup, singing immediately afterward, continuous singing through all sections, no instrumental break, complete sung ending followed by one short final chord. No spoken narration.
